confirmedInterfaces.name: compileReferenceCameraTrack
confirmedInterfaces.behavior: Consumes Scene-owned integer-frame keyframes and the unchanged actual V5 camera plan. Fixed monotone cubic interpolation in center and log extent gives C1 continuity. First frame0 and last frame149 remain mandatory for this fixture. Repeated poses are accepted. The last keyframe must remain the closest extent.

confirmedInterfaces.name: evaluateReferenceCameraTrackFrame
confirmedInterfaces.behavior: Random access by output frame. Camera and event state do not share a remapped clock. cameraLocked:false means no arrival/detail lock is forged. It does not promise a nonzero numerical camera velocity on every frame.

confirmedInterfaces.name: assessReferenceCameraMotion
confirmedInterfaces.behavior: Checks all150 camera samples and returns step metrics. fakeLockCount:0 is a literal output field, not a sampled detector for pose plateaus. It cannot certify whether an intentional read pause exists.

confirmedInterfaces.name: compileReferencePresentationPlan
confirmedInterfaces.behavior: Roll follows its own Scene-owned keyframes with C1 interpolation. A real camera-pose read pause must hold roll as well as center and extent. Overscan/no-corner-clipping constraints remain unchanged.

confirmedInterfaces.name: nativeFramingFloor
confirmedInterfaces.behavior: Every native frame must remain wider and taller than the inherited admitted floor. No profile can weaken this guard.

confirmedInterfaces.name: eventAndObjectFrameOwnership
confirmedInterfaces.behavior: Territory is evaluated at control.startFrame+frame and units at frame. Camera-only Scene keyframes must not remap either index or change their source arrays.

confirmedInterfaces.name: assertQualityDiagnostic
confirmedInterfaces.behavior: Existing geometry, GPU, native floor, safe area, collision and cameraLocked:false checks remain active. A separate declared camera-read pause must not be passed off as DETAIL LOCK.

CameraSmoothing.possible: Bounded new Scene-owned camera cadence or keyframe adjustment through the existing C1 interpolators. Zero/disabled must retain original F exactly.
notClaimed: Guaranteed reference-quality motion before actual video review

HoldDuration.possible: Optional camera-pose read pause of0 or9..12 displayed frames, selected after a meaningful change and filtered by all safety/visibility checks.
HoldDuration.unit: Displayed frames for deterministic30fps capture; exact public parameter unit to be pinned during Stage G.
unsupported: Territory expansion hold or story retiming
HoldDuration.offByOneRule: A declared N-frame pause must be verified from N displayed samples, not inferred from a keyframe delta that accidentally yields N+1 samples.

actualReferenceConstraint.observation: The selected reference window tracks and changes scale. No long static camera lock is observed. An optional short readability pause is a new bounded visual choice, not a copied measured reference hold.
